program:
app "Ping pong" ball plum
table point team pick Left|Right, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Left)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Right)
setting winat num = 21 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Left" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Left, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Left, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Left, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Right" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Right, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Right, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Right, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Left win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Right win!" head color good
describe:
Ping pong, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Left, Right; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 21.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Left.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Right.
Shows:
- text: "Left".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 3.
- text: "Right".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 3.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Left win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Right win!".
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Trip budget" plane mint
table trip_cost what text, amount money, category pick Hotel|Food|Transport|Tickets|Shopping, note text?
let spent = sum(trip_cost.amount month)
setting budget money = 120000 "Monthly budget"
"Last month" sum(trip_cost.amount prev month) faint
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form trip_cost
share trip_cost month by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
list trip_cost month by day
describe:
Trip budget, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- trip cost: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Hotel, Food, Transport, Tickets, Shopping; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 120000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of trip cost this month.
Shows:
- text: "Last month", the total amount of trip cost last month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a trip cost.
- bars that compare the total amount of the item across group of trip cost entries this month by category.
- a list of trip cost this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Work timer" clock ink
table entry task text, mins num 1..
state what text = ""
state going bool = no
state began when = now
field what "Working on"
if going
  "Working on" what head
  button "Stop" tap add entry task = what, mins = max(round((now - began) / 1m), 1) then set going = no
else
  button "Start" tap set began = now then set going = yes
"Today" sum(entry.mins today) "min" big
daybars last 7 days, sum(entry.mins on it)
list entry by day
describe:
Work timer, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- entry: task: text; mins: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: what, starting at ""; going, starting at no; began, starting at now.
Shows:
- a box to fill in what, labelled "Working on".
- if going:
  - text: "Working on", what.
  - a button "Stop"; a tap adds a entry with task set to what, mins set to the larger of the result of now minus began divided by 1 minute rounded and 1, then sets going to no.
- otherwise:
  - a button "Start"; a tap sets began to now, then sets going to yes.
- text: "Today", the total mins of entry today, "min".
- a bar chart of the total mins of entry on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of entry by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Tennis" ball slate
table point team pick Me|Rival, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Me)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Rival)
setting winat num = 6 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Me" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Me, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Me, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Rival" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Rival, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Rival, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Me win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Rival win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Tennis, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Me, Rival; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 6.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Me.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Rival.
Shows:
- text: "Me".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Me, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Me, pts set to 2.
- text: "Rival".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Rival, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Rival, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Me win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Rival win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Salon" tag slate
table client name text, phone text?
table service name text, price money
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3
table visit client ref client, service ref service, paid money
let income = sum(visit.paid month)
screen home "Today" calendar
  stat income, "income this month"
  stat count(visit today), "appointments today"
  form visit, "Book appointment"
  each visit today as v
    row card
      v.client.name bold grow
      v.service.name
      v.paid
screen clients "Clients" users
  each client sort name as c
    row card tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name bold grow
      count(c.visit) "visits" faint
  form client, "Add client"
screen prices "Prices" tag
  list service
  form service, "Add service"
screen stock "Stock" package
  each product sort qty as p
    row card gap 1 tap edit p
      p.name bold grow color if(p.qty <= p.low, warn, ink)
      button "-" tap set p.qty = p.qty - 1
      p.qty bold
      button "+" tap set p.qty = p.qty + 1
  form product, "Add product"
screen money "Income" wallet
  stat income, "this month"
  stat sum(visit.paid prev month), "last month"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(visit.paid on it)
  list visit by day
describe:
Salon, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- client: name: text; phone: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- service: name: text; price: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- product: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- visit: client: a client; service: a service; paid: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- income is the total paid of visit this month.
Shows:
- a screen "Today":
  - a big number: income, labelled "income this month".
  - a big number: how many visit entries today, labelled "appointments today".
  - a form to add a visit.
  - for each visit today:
    - text: the client name of the visit.
    - text: the service name of the visit.
    - text: the paid of the visit.
- a screen "Clients":
  - for each client sorted by name:
    - a group; a tap opens the client for editing; a swipe removes the client, with undo:
      - text: the name of the client.
      - text: how many the client's visit entries, "visits".
  - a form to add a client.
- a screen "Prices":
  - a list of service; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
  - a form to add a service.
- a screen "Stock":
  - for each product sorted by qty:
    - a group; a tap opens the product for editing:
      - text: the name of the product.
      - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product minus 1.
      - text: the qty of the product.
      - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product plus 1.
  - a form to add a product.
- a screen "Income":
  - a big number: income, labelled "this month".
  - a big number: the total paid of visit last month, labelled "last month".
  - a bar chart of the total paid of visit on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of visit by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first
